urgent.heading: Fika emtholampilo noma esibhedlela ngokushesha uma
urgent.primary_message: Ukutheleleka kwesinye isinye kungasakazekela ezinso nasemithanjeni yegazi. Izimpawu ezingezansi zisho ukuthi ukutheleleka sekuqhubekele phambili - kudinga ukwelashwa ngokushesha.
red_flags: Ukushisa okuphezulu, ukuqhaqhazela, noma ukujuluka okunezimpawu ze-UTI
Ubuhlungu obukhulu emhlane noma ohlangothini (ezungeze izinso)
Ukudideka noma ukozela okwedlulele - ikakhulukazi kubantu abadala
Izimpawu ze-UTI endodeni (engavamile kakhulu, ngokuvamile eyingozi kakhulu)

what_is_it.heading: UTI ngokwemibandela ecacile
what_is_it.lede: Ukutheleleka komgudu womchamo kwenzeka lapho amagciwane - ngokuvamile aphuma emathunjini - engena ohlelweni lomchamo futhi anda. Iningi lithinta isinye (cystitis). Kwesinye isikhathi zifinyelela izinso (pyelonephritis), okuyinto embi kakhulu.
paragraphs: Ama-UTI avame kakhulu kwabesifazane ngoba ishubhu lomchamo (urethra) lifushane, ngakho amagciwane afika esinyeni kalula. Cishe isigamu sabesifazane bane-UTI okungenani eyodwa ekuphileni kwabo. I-UTI emadodeni, izingane, noma ukukhulelwa ayivamile futhi idinga ukunakwa okuseduze.

Iningi lama-UTIs esinyeni alulama ngokushesha ngenkambo emfushane yemithi elwa namagciwane. Uma zingalashwa, zingasakazeka ziye phezulu ezinso, lapho ukutheleleka kuba kubi kakhulu - ngezinye izikhathi kusongela ukuphila. Ungazibi izimpawu ngethemba lokuthi zizohamba.

items.headline: Ingxenye yabesifazane
items.body: Bayoba okungenani ne-UTI eyodwa ekuphileni kwabo. Abaningi banezimbalwa. Kungesinye sezizathu ezivame kakhulu zokuvakashela emtholampilo.

items.headline: Ama-antibiotic ayasebenza
items.body: Iningi lama-UTI alula liyacaca ezinsukwini ezi-2-3 enkambweni emfushane yama-antibiotic. Phuza amanzi amaningi eceleni.

items.headline: Ingasabalala
items.body: I-UTI engelashiwe ingasakazekela ezinso - i-pyelonephritis. Lokhu kubangela imfiva, ubuhlungu beqolo, futhi ngezinye izikhathi i-sepsis. Isimo esiphuthumayo sangempela.

items.headline: Chama ngemva kocansi
items.body: Ucansi luyimbangela evamile ye-UTI kwabesifazane. Ukuchama kungakapheli imizuzu engama-30 kukhipha amagciwane. Easy nsuku zonke zokuvimbela umkhuba.

pull_quote.text: Ungazami ukwelapha izimpawu ze-UTI ngejusi ye-cranberry namanzi kuphela. Zingasiza ekuvimbeleni ukutheleleka esikhathini esizayo kodwa ngeke zisule okukhona. Thola ama-antibiotics - ukwelashwa kusenesikhathi kuvimbela ukubandakanyeka kwezinso.

signs.heading: Ungasho kanjani lokho onakho
signs.lede: I-UTI yesinye kanye ne-UTI yezinso zinezimpawu ezithile - kodwa i-UTI yezinso yengeza imfiva nobuhlungu beqolo. Umehluko ubaluleke kakhulu.

items.title: I-UTI yesinye (cystitis)
items.description: Ukushiswa lapho uchama, udinga ukuchama kaningi, isidingo esiphuthumayo sokuchama kodwa kuphuma amanani amancane kuphela, umchamo onamafu noma onukayo, ukungakhululeki kwe-pelvic noma ngaphansi kwesisu. Awukho umkhuhlane.

items.title: I-UTI yezinso (pyelonephritis)
items.description: Konke lokhu okungenhla kwe-PLUS fever, ukuqhaqhazela, ubuhlungu obukhulu emhlane noma ohlangothini, isicanucanu nokuhlanza. Lokhu kudinga ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo - kwesinye isikhathi isibhedlela.

items.title: UTI ngamaqembu akhethekile
items.description: Ukukhulelwa, izingane, abantu abadala, namadoda - i-UTI ingabonakala kancane (ukudideka kubantu asebekhulile, ukucasuka nje ezinganeni) futhi kubi nakakhulu. Njalo hlola.

prevention.heading: Ungawehlisa kanjani amathuba akho
prevention.lede: Uma uthola ama-UTI aphindelelayo, imikhuba yansuku zonke yenza umehluko wangempela. Izinto ezincane, zenziwe ngokungaguquki.

items.title: Phuza amanzi amaningi
items.description: Khomba u-1.5-2 wamalitha ngosuku, ngaphezulu lapho kushisa noma ngokuzivocavoca. Umchamo ohlanjululwe kanye nokushaywa njalo kugcina amagciwane angaziphindaphindi.

items.title: Chama lapho udinga
items.description: Ungalubambi. Chama ngokugcwele — ungajahi. Ukubamba umchamo kunikeza amagciwane isikhathi sokuphindaphinda esinyeni esifudumele, esimnyama.

items.title: Chama kungakapheli imizuzu engama-30 ngemuva kocansi
items.description: Ikhipha amagciwane okungenzeka ukuthi angena ngesikhathi socansi. Mhlawumbe umkhuba owodwa ophumelela kakhulu wokuvimbela kwabesifazane abenza ucansi.

items.title: Sula ngaphambili ukuya emuva
items.description: Ikakhulukazi ngemva kokunyakaza kwamathumbu. Ivimbela amagciwane amathumbu ukuthi angangeni eshubhu lomchamo - umthombo ovame kakhulu wamagciwane e-UTI.

items.title: Hamba emtholampilo ukuze uthole ama-antibiotic afanele
items.description: Kumahhala kunoma yimuphi umtholampilo kahulumeni. Ukuhlolwa komchamo kuqinisekisa ukutheleleka. Ukwelashwa okufushane kwama-antibiotic (imvamisa izinsuku ezi-3-5) kuqeda ama-UTI amaningi. Ungazami ukuyikhipha.

items.title: Phuza amanzi amaningi
items.description: Ikakhulukazi ngenkathi izimpawu zisebenza. Isiza ukususa amagciwane, inciphisa ubuhlungu lapho uchama. Hlela okungenani amalitha ama-2 ngosuku ngesikhathi sokutheleleka.

items.title: Qedela inkambo yama-antibiotic - ngisho noma kungcono
items.description: Abantu abaningi bazizwa bengcono emahoreni angama-24-48. Inkambo ephelele yiyona eqeda amagciwane futhi ivimbele ukubuya. Ukumisa ukumelana nezinhlobo zakuqala.

items.title: Uma umkhuhlane noma ubuhlungu beqolo buvela - hamba ngaphandle kokulibala
items.description: Lokhu kusho ukuthi isifo sesifikile ezinso. Idinga ukwelashwa okunamandla okuphuthumayo - kwesinye isikhathi isibhedlela. Ungalindi kuze kuse.

items.title: Uma uthola i-UTI kaningi - bonana nodokotela
items.description: Ama-UTI avamile (3+ ngonyaka) adinga uphenyo. Kungase kube nembangela engelaphekayo, kanye nezinketho zokuvimbela isikhathi eside zikhona.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: I-UTI ingesinye sezizathu ezivame kakhulu abantu abavakashela emitholampilo. Ukwelashwa kumahhala, kuyashesha, futhi kuyasebenza - asikho isidingo sokuhlupheka.

helplines.name: I-ambulensi yezimo eziphuthumayo
helplines.description: Nge-UTI yezinso enomkhuhlane ophezulu, iqolo elibuhlungu, noma ukuhlanza

helplines.name: Thola umtholampilo oseduze nawe
helplines.description: Ukuhlolwa komchamo kwamahhala, ukuhlolwa, kanye nama-antibiotics
